name: motif_start_proposal
description: Starts a new Draft Proposal: a named container for one small, related set of changes. Give it a short draft name (letters, digits and hyphens), a one-line label a person reads in Motif's window, such as 'Add the plural suffix -s', and a comment explaining why the change is right, which the linguist reads while deciding. Keep each Proposal to one concept. Returns the draft name and the proposal id; use the draft name with the motif_add_* tools and the proposal id with motif_trial.

label.description: A one-line description a reviewer reads in Motif's window.

comment.description: Why this change is right: the evidence, in a few sentences.

name: motif_add_natural_class
description: Authors a natural class in a Draft. Supply exactly one nonempty list: members (phoneme ids) or features (closed phonological feature/value pairs). Its abbreviation must be unique and use letters, digits or hyphens. References may name objects authored earlier in this Draft. Returns the class entityId. Next: author its context with motif_add_environment using this class id.

abbreviation.description: Unique environment abbreviation, such as V.

members.description: Phoneme ids in the first set.

feature.description: Closed feature id in the phonological feature system.

value.description: Symbolic value belonging to that feature.

features.description: Closed phonological feature/value pairs; copy ids from motif_grammar.

name: motif_edit_natural_class
description: Adds or removes members of one existing segment natural class after comparing its exact current phoneme identities. The desired class must remain nonempty, and feature classes cannot change subtype in place. The result lists environments, rewrite rules and insertions that still use the class. This only stages a Draft; only a person can Apply it.

target.description: Canonical id of the existing segment natural class.

expectedMembers.description: Exact current phoneme ids in the class.

members.description: Requested distinct phoneme ids; the class must remain nonempty.

name: motif_relink_natural_class
description: Moves only the named environment and rewrite-rule context users from one natural class to another class created earlier in this Draft. Supply each environment's exact typed left and right contexts; each relink depends on the replacement class creation. RelatedObjects lists the source class's current users for scope review. This only stages a Draft; only a person can Apply it.

source.description: Canonical id of the class users currently reference.

replacement.description: Canonical id of the replacement class.

replacementCreationOperation.description: Operation id returned by the class create earlier in this Draft.

phoneme.description: Phoneme id in the first phoneme set.

naturalClass.description: Natural class id with a unique abbreviation.

boundary.description: Word edge or declared morpheme boundary.

expectedLeft.description: Context items in linguistic order, from the outer left to outer right. Each names exactly one reference.

phoneme.description: Phoneme id in the first phoneme set.

naturalClass.description: Natural class id with a unique abbreviation.

boundary.description: Word edge or declared morpheme boundary.

expectedRight.description: Context items in linguistic order, from the outer left to outer right. Each names exactly one reference.

environments.description: Explicit environment users and their exact current typed contexts.

ruleContexts.description: Explicit rewrite-rule context object ids using the source class.

name: motif_add_phonological_rule
description: Stages one simple regular rewrite rule in a Draft. Input and output each contain at most one phoneme or natural class; an empty side means insertion or deletion. left and right are ordered lists of one to eight phoneme, class, boundary, or boundaryMarker contexts. A boundaryMarker id stays literal even when its code is #; use boundary='word' for the word edge. placement names the adjacent existing rule or rules. Alpha variables, metathesis and allomorph environments are unsupported. Returns created rule identities and operation details. Next: finish the Proposal, inspect motif_dry_run, and test parse and generate behavior with motif_trial.

direction.description: Rule scan direction or application mode.

phoneme.description: Phoneme id in the first phoneme set.

naturalClass.description: Natural class id owned by this project's phonological data.

input.description: Zero or one explicit phoneme or natural-class items.

phoneme.description: Phoneme id in the first phoneme set.

naturalClass.description: Natural class id owned by this project's phonological data.

output.description: Zero or one explicit phoneme or natural-class items.

phoneme.description: Phoneme id in the first phoneme set.

naturalClass.description: Natural class id with a unique abbreviation.

boundary.description: Word edge or declared morpheme boundary.

boundaryMarker.description: Stored boundary-marker id. Rule contexts preserve its literal identity, even when its code is #.

left.description: Context items in linguistic order, from the outer left to outer right. Each names exactly one reference.

phoneme.description: Phoneme id in the first phoneme set.

naturalClass.description: Natural class id with a unique abbreviation.

boundary.description: Word edge or declared morpheme boundary.

boundaryMarker.description: Stored boundary-marker id. Rule contexts preserve its literal identity, even when its code is #.

right.description: Context items in linguistic order, from the outer left to outer right. Each names exactly one reference.

after.description: Adjacent existing rule before the insertion gap.

before.description: Adjacent existing rule after the insertion gap.

name: motif_add_affix_slot
description: Stages a new inflectional affix slot owned by an existing category, gives it a name and optionality, and can assign existing inflectional affixes to it in the same Draft. Assignments must fit the slot category. This only stages a Proposal, and only a person can Apply it. Next: finish the Draft, inspect motif_dry_run, and run a bounded motif_trial on affected words.

category.description: Canonical id of the existing category that owns the new slot.

name.description: Slot name in the project's writing system.

ws.description: Writing system tag for the slot name.

optional.description: Whether forms may omit this slot.

assignments.description: Optional canonical ids of existing inflectional affix MSAs to assign.

name: motif_add_affix_template
description: Stages an active alternative affix template in a Draft, preserving the category's existing template order. prefix_slots and suffix_slots are ordered canonical ids for existing slots or slots created earlier in this Draft; each must belong to the template category or an ancestor, and no slot may be repeated. final records whether the template requires further derivation. This only stages a Proposal, and only a person can Apply it. Next: finish the Draft, inspect motif_dry_run, and run a bounded motif_trial on affected words.

category.description: Canonical id of the existing category that owns the template.

name.description: Template name in the project's writing system.

ws.description: Writing system tag for the template name.

prefix_slots.description: Ordered canonical ids of prefix slots.

suffix_slots.description: Ordered canonical ids of suffix slots.

final.description: Whether the template requires further derivation.

name: motif_retire_allomorph
description: Stages removal of an ordinary prefix or suffix alternate after every live use has an exact destination among the entry's duplicate forms. It refuses changed forms, unsupported references and owned dependents; the Draft can be checked with motif_dry_run before a person Applies it.

intent_json.description: Closed motif-retire-allomorph/v1 JSON with exact source, destination and reference identities.

name: motif_edit_adhoc_prohibition
description: Stages one explicit Disabled value for a flat allomorph or morpheme prohibition in a Draft. expected_disabled must match the target's current value; grouped prohibitions are refused. This only stages a Proposal, and only a person can Apply it. Next: finish the Draft, inspect motif_dry_run, and compare bounded before and after Trials with the same words.

target.description: Canonical id of one flat allomorph or morpheme prohibition.

expected_disabled.description: The value the target must currently have.

disabled.description: The explicit Disabled value to write.

name: motif_edit_affix_slot
description: Changes whether one existing affix slot is optional. The response lists every inflectional affix and template using that shared slot; this only stages a Draft, and only a person can Apply it.

target.description: Canonical id of the existing affix slot.

expected_optional.description: The optionality the project must currently have.

name: motif_edit_affix_template
description: Reorders the existing prefix and suffix slots of one affix template using explicit slot identities. It cannot add or remove slots or create a template; this only stages a Draft, and only a person can Apply it.

target.description: Canonical id of the existing affix template.

expected_prefix_slots.description: Current prefix slot ids in project order.

prefix_slots.description: Requested prefix slot ids in explicit order.

expected_suffix_slots.description: Current suffix slot ids in project order.

suffix_slots.description: Requested suffix slot ids in explicit order.

name: motif_edit_inflectional_affix
description: Changes the slot membership of one existing inflectional affix MSA. Slots must belong to its category or an ancestor; other MSA subtypes are refused. This only stages a Draft, and only a person can Apply it.

target.description: Canonical id of the existing inflectional affix MSA.

expected_slots.description: Current slot ids assigned to the MSA.

slots.description: Requested slot ids; order has no meaning.

name: motif_edit_allomorph_condition
description: Replaces one existing allomorph's environment references after checking the exact current list. Use field=phoneEnv for a stem or affix OR-list, and field=position for an affix's ordered position choices. The edit changes only this allomorph, so other users of a shared environment keep their references. This only stages a Draft; only a person can Apply it.

target.description: Canonical id of the existing stem or affix allomorph.

expected_environments.description: Current environment ids; order matters only for position.

environments.description: Requested environment ids; order matters only for position.

name: motif_order_allomorphs
description: Reorders the existing alternate forms within one entry using explicit neighboring anchors. The lexeme form is outside that sequence and cannot be moved. Earlier forms have selection precedence; a final unrestricted form may serve as an elsewhere fallback. This only stages a Draft; only a person can Apply it.

target.description: Canonical id of the owning lexical entry.

expected_alternates.description: Current alternate-form ids in project order.

alternates.description: Requested order of those same alternate forms.

name: motif_parsimony_record_types
description: Lists the saved Notebook record types and their portable ids. Choose a type by its id, never by its English name. Use the selected id with motif_dispose_parsimony_finding.

name: motif_dispose_parsimony_finding
description: Stages a keep, fix, ask or defer decision from one exact finding in a stored Parsimony Report. Motif derives the subject, evidence digest, evidence contract and captions from that finding. Choose record_type_id from motif_parsimony_record_types. A reason is optional; ask requires a question. This only stages a Draft Proposal: only a person can Apply it, and a pending keep does not suppress findings.

report_id.description: Id of a stored Parsimony Report from this project.

finding_id.description: Exact finding id returned by that Report.

reason.description: Optional explanation, stored with the readable record.

question.description: Required only when disposition is ask.

name: motif_dry_run
description: Checks that a finished Proposal's changes fit the project by applying them to a throwaway copy, and reports what each change did. It does not touch the real project. The Proposal must be finished with motif_finish_proposal first. If it takes longer than wait_seconds you get status 'running' and a job id: call again with that job to keep waiting.

job.description: A job id from an earlier 'running' result, to keep waiting for it.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result. Default 40.

detail.description: 'concise' (default) drops empty fields and long lists; 'detailed' returns everything.

limit.description: The most list items to return in concise mode. Default 25.

name: motif_finish_proposal
description: Finishes a Draft so it becomes a Proposal the linguist can review in Motif's window. Do this before a dry run or trial, which require a finished Proposal. Finishing does not change the project; the linguist decides whether to apply it. After finishing, the draft is closed: further edits start from a copy.

expected_revision.description: The revision you last read, to refuse if the draft changed.

name: motif_parsimony_measures
description: Lists the supported Parsimony measures and their fixed evidence views, capabilities, evidence tiers, citations and recipe links. This reads the same catalog as motif parsimony measures; it does not run a measure or launch a job.

name: motif_run_parsimony_measure
description: Runs one registered Parsimony measure and returns its stored Report, using the same command handlers and Report shape as the CLI. It may take a while; if it returns running, repeat with the job id. This is advisory evidence only. A Proposal still needs Dry Run and only a person can Apply it.

job.description: Job id from a previous running result; omit to start a new measure.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for a result. Default 40.

name: motif_parsimony_report
description: Reads one stored Parsimony Report by its exact id. The Report payload is the same serialized response returned by motif parsimony show; reading it does not start a parser run.

name: motif_retirement_review
description: Reads the review state for one staged rule-based allomorph retirement Draft. It returns its latest matching Dry Run and names evidence that is not available yet; it never invents a finding or parser result.

name: motif_parsimony_view
description: Reads one page from a fixed Parsimony evidence or Active/Suppressed view. Filters are typed, bounded fields; arbitrary SQL or query text is not accepted. Missing evidence is reported with its status and detail, while saved judgments remain visible as unavailable. This read never launches a job; rerun a measure explicitly when new evidence is needed.

report_id.description: Stored Report id for finding views.

object_id.description: Exact object GUID filter where the view accepts one.

category_id.description: Exact category GUID filter for template-order views.

subject_key.description: Exact finding or judgment subject key.

search.description: Bounded search over returned captions and reasons.

limit.description: Rows in this page. Default 50, maximum 200.

cursor.description: Next cursor from the same bundle, view and filters.

name: motif_revise_parsimony_disposition
description: Stages a revision of one saved Parsimony disposition in a Draft. Name the exact current head set and content digests; a conflict can be resolved only by naming every head. The revised choice keeps the same finding subject and evidence, and only a person can Apply it.

recordId.description: Notebook record id of a current disposition head.

revisionId.description: Portable id of the current revision.

contentDigest.description: Canonical sha256 digest read with the revision.

expectedHeads.description: Every current head with its exact content digest.

reason.description: Replacement reason; omit to preserve the current reason.

name: motif_retract_parsimony_disposition
description: Stages a withdrawal of one saved Parsimony disposition in a Draft. Name the exact current head set and content digests; a conflict can be resolved only by naming every head. The Notebook history stays intact, and the finding returns to Active only after a person Applies the current retraction; only a person can Apply it.

recordId.description: Notebook record id of a current disposition head.

revisionId.description: Portable id of the current revision.

contentDigest.description: Canonical sha256 digest read with the revision.

expectedHeads.description: Every current head with its exact content digest.
